stemMd:
A shipment consists only of boxes holding either 7 or 11 instruments. How many 11-instrument boxes are there?

(1) There are 18 boxes.

(2) There are 154 instruments.
instructionsMd: Determine whether the question has a unique answer from each statement separately, then from both together if needed. For a yes/no question, a definite no is sufficient.

options.label: A
options.textMd: Statement (1) alone is sufficient; statement (2) alone is not.

options.label: B
options.textMd: Statement (2) alone is sufficient; statement (1) alone is not.

options.label: C
options.textMd: Together the statements are sufficient; neither is sufficient alone.

options.label: E
options.textMd: The statements are not sufficient even together.

explanationMd: The box count alone leaves the split unknown. The instrument total alone allows 22 seven-instrument boxes and no eleven-instrument boxes, or 11 seven-instrument boxes and 7 eleven-instrument boxes, among other cases. Together let b be eleven-instrument boxes: 7(18-b)+11b=154 gives b=7.
